real_defects.issue: billedOn compared unrounded weights, so a package whose dimensional weight rounds to the same billed pound as its goods (16x12x10, 13.7 lb: 13.81 vs 13.7, both bill 14 lb) was reported as billed on dimensional weight with '0 lb of it is air' and a lever to shrink a box that would not lower the bill; the break-even cube also used unrounded actual weight (4.2 lb bills 5 lb, so any cube to 695 in3 bills the same, but the lever said 583.8). Fixed: compare ceil(dim) > ceil(actual), break-even = ceil(actual) x divisor; two failing-first tests; levers.test fixture 7.2 lb (whose real headroom is 13.7%, not 4.3%) moved to 7 lb; how-to page and README wording say 'rounded up to the next pound'.

certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
